title: Specialty Pharmacy Delivery Scheduling Allowance (Formulary Benefit Transition Supplies)
content:
Under the Formulary Benefit, a specialty transition supply carries a scheduling allowance for the time the specialty pharmacy needs to book a delivery. The allowance turns on two records: which pharmacy dispensed the member's latest shipped specialty fill of the drug, and the delivery scheduling lead that the member's Specialty Pharmacy Program sets for the drug, counted in business days.

## Clause

| Latest shipped fill dispensed by | Program's delivery scheduling lead | Allowance added |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy | at least **3** | the scheduling lead itself, counted as days |
| Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy | fewer than 3 | **1** day (the short-lead allowance) |
| any other pharmacy | any | none |

The allowance is added to the supply's dose-cycle days. Only after that is the supply held between zero and the formulary's maximum days supply for one transition fill.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical leads, fill dispensed by Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy)

| Lead | Allowance |
|---|---|
| 4 business days | 4 days |
| 3 business days | 3 days, since a lead equal to the threshold counts as at least 3 |
| 2 business days | 1 day |

*Basis Q&A.* Is a lead of 5 business days converted into calendar days before it is added? No. The scheduling lead is added as that number of days.
